stemMd: In a group, $P(M)=0.6$, $P(N\mid M)=0.5$, and $P(N\mid M^c)=0.25$. Find $P(N)$.
explanationMd: Partition by M: $P(N)=0.6(0.5)+0.4(0.25)=0.3+0.1=0.4$. Each conditional rate must be weighted by its group share.

distractorRationale.b: Includes only the contribution from M.
distractorRationale.a: Uses the non-M conditional rate for the whole population.
